sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Persona data and picture imports
sections.what: Brings in the sport picture component and the persona list with its slug type.
sections.why: Likely reason: the chip needs the persona details and sport picture from elsewhere in the app.

sections.name: PersonaChip
sections.title: Persona chip display
sections.what: Shows the persona name in a pill with its coloured circle and sport picture, plus an AI analyst tag that is always present.
sections.why: Likely reason: makes it clear who is speaking and that it is an AI.
sections.watch_out: Removing the AI tag would break the rule that every persona is labelled as an AI analyst.

summary: A small chip showing an AI analyst persona with its colour, sport picture, name and the words AI analyst.
purpose: Shows which analyst a fan is reading and always marks it as AI, so no one takes it for a person.
why: The comment says every persona is labelled as an AI analyst.
how: Looks up the persona by its slug, colours a circle with the persona's colour, draws its sport picture, then shows its name and the AI analyst tag.
inputs: persona (a slug such as opener or iceman).
risks: An unknown slug has no matching entry, so the lookup returns nothing and the chip fails when displayed.
debug: If the chip fails to render, check the slug spelling and that it exists in the personas data. If the picture is wrong, check the sport key for that persona.
